 Mahindra XUV 7XO Prices Hiked by Up to ₹20,000 in October 2026 – Check Revised Variant-Wise Prices
 Team Autopunditz 4 minutes ago 4 min read Mahindra has increased prices of select XUV 7XO variants by ₹7,499 to ₹20,000. The flagship SUV continues to start at ₹13.99 lakh, while the top-spec diesel AWD variant remains priced at ₹25.79 lakh (ex-showroom). 
 Mahindra & Mahindra has revised the prices of its flagship internal-combustion SUV, the Mahindra XUV 7XO , in India. The latest October 2026 revision makes several petrol and diesel two-wheel-drive variants more expensive by up to ₹20,000 . 
 The highest increase applies to the AX7 Diesel Manual , which is now priced at ₹19.80 lakh, following a ₹20,000 hike. 
 However, Mahindra has kept the price of the entry-level AX petrol manual unchanged at ₹13.99 lakh. The range-topping AX7L diesel automatic with all-wheel drive also retains its ₹25.79 lakh ex-showroom price. 
 The revision follows an earlier increase in July 2026, when prices of the XUV 7XO were raised by up to ₹88,000. 
 Mahindra XUV 7XO Price Hike – Key Highlights 
 Prices increased by ₹7,499 to ₹20,000 across select variants. 
 Maximum hike of ₹20,000 on the AX7 Diesel MT. 
 AX petrol manual remains priced at ₹13.99 lakh. 
 AX7L Diesel AWD AT remains unchanged at ₹25.79 lakh. 
 Petrol and diesel two-wheel-drive variants are primarily affected. 
 No corresponding changes to engine specifications or equipment have been reported. 
 Revised ex-showroom price range remains ₹13.99–25.79 lakh.

 AX7 Diesel Manual Gets the Highest Increase 
 Among the affected variants, the AX7 Diesel MT receives the largest price revision. 
 Its price has increased from ₹19.60 lakh to ₹19.80 lakh, representing a ₹20,000 increase. 
 Interestingly, Mahindra has not increased the price of the top-spec diesel AWD automatic variant. 
 This means the latest revision primarily affects customers shopping for two-wheel-drive configurations rather than the flagship AWD model. 
 Second Major Price Revision in 2026 
 The October revision follows an earlier increase in July 2026, when Mahindra raised XUV 7XO prices by as much as ₹88,000. 
 The SUV originally entered the Indian market in January 2026 at a starting price of ₹13.66 lakh. 
 Its current starting price of ₹13.99 lakh is ₹33,000 higher than the introductory entry price. 
 However, the cumulative increase differs substantially between variants, depending on how their prices changed during July and October. 
 The latest October adjustment is relatively modest compared with the earlier revision, but it adds to the overall acquisition cost for buyers considering selected mid- and higher-spec variants. 
 Mahindra XUV 7XO Engine and Transmission Options 
 The latest price revision does not bring any reported mechanical changes. 
 The SUV continues with two familiar powertrain options.

 The petrol engine is focused on strong performance, while the diesel engine provides higher torque and the option of all-wheel drive on selected versions. The XUV 7XO continues to target customers looking for a feature-rich, three-row family SUV. 
 Key Features Remain Unchanged 
 Depending on the variant, the XUV 7XO offers: 
 Triple 12.3-inch digital-screen layout 
 Panoramic sunroof 
 Level 2 ADAS 
 540-degree camera system 
 Harman Kardon premium audio system 
 Ventilated seats 
 Powered front seats 
 Electronic stability control 
 Six airbags as standard 
 Seven airbags on selected higher variants 
 Six- and seven-seat configurations 
 The SUV also holds a five-star Bharat NCAP safety rating, strengthening its positioning among safety-conscious family buyers. 
 Does the Price Hike Affect the XUV 7XO's Value Proposition? 
 The Mahindra XUV 7XO competes in a segment that includes the Tata Safari, Hyundai Alcazar and MG Hector Plus. The latest increase is relatively small when viewed against the SUV's overall price. 
 However, buyers comparing closely priced variants could find the additional ₹10,000–₹20,000 significant, particularly after accounting for registration charges, insurance and other on-road expenses. 
 The unchanged starting and flagship AWD prices help Mahindra maintain its advertised entry-level affordability and premium diesel AWD positioning. 
 Customers with existing bookings should confirm the applicable invoice price and any 
 price-protection terms with their dealership. 
 Mahindra XUV 7XO prices increased by up to ₹20,000 in October 2026. The AX7 Diesel MT receives the highest hike, while the starting price remains unchanged at ₹13.99 lakh. Auto Punditz Take 
 The October 2026 price increase is another incremental upward adjustment for the Mahindra XUV 7XO. 
 Unlike the broader July revision, the latest increase is largely concentrated on selected two-wheel-drive petrol and diesel variants. 
 The most notable development is the ₹20,000 increase on the AX7 Diesel MT, while Mahindra has protected the ₹13.99 lakh entry price and ₹25.79 lakh flagship AWD price. 
 From a competitive standpoint, the XUV 7XO continues to offer a compelling combination of engine performance, cabin technology, safety equipment and seating flexibility. 
 However, repeated price increases could gradually reduce the price advantage of certain variants against competing three-row SUVs. 
 For customers already planning to purchase the XUV 7XO, the latest revision is unlikely to fundamentally change the SUV's appeal. Buyers should nevertheless compare the revised on-road price with equivalent variants of the Tata Safari, Hyundai Alcazar and MG Hector Plus before making a decision.
